$comment: The Checkbox page also shows Joinery's own checkbox-indeterminate; it has no upstream counterpart, so it isn't mapped.

checkbox-demo.reason: A FieldTitle's line height. Upstream's cn() drops the field-title rule's leading-snug for the text-sm after it in Nova, so its title is 20px tall; scripts/port-styles.mjs keeps a rule's classes as written, so Joinery's is 19.25px and what follows each title sits 0.75px higher. Fixing it means port-styles.mjs applying tailwind-merge within each rule, as upstream's cn() does (the field-title rules, Sera's label and the combobox content, across the eight sheets).
